definition: a collection; an assemblage; a crowd.
example_en: A crowd of people had gathered in the field.

definition: the act of carrying a load, burden on one's head or shoulders.
example: ಅವನು ಸೌದೆಯ ಹೊಱಿಗೆಯನ್ನು ಬೆನ್ನ ಮೇಲೆ ಹೊತ್ತನು.
example_en: He carried the load of firewood on his back.

definition: belief in devotion to a god or gods.
example_en: Her devotion to god was an example to the whole village.

definition: a kind of evergreen tree akin to Pongamia glabra.
example_en: Muḷḷuvonge trees have grown at the edge of the forest.

definition: a path at a lower level.
example: ಆ ಕೀೞ್ವೞಿಯ ಮೂಲಕ ಹಳ್ಳಿಗರು ನದಿಗೆ ಹೋಗುತ್ತಿದ್ದರು.
example_en: The villagers used to go to the river through that lower path.

definition: a stand or shelf of low height.
example_en: He arranged the books on the low stand.

definition: a small water jug with a nozzle.
example_en: There was a small nozzled water jug in the kitchen.

definition: a red-coloured wild dog (Cuon alpinus), which hunts in packs, attacking even large game; a dhole.
example_en: The dholes hunted a large animal in a pack.

definition: the grammar of a language.
example_en: Without knowing the grammar, one cannot write the language correctly.

definition: a (usu. brief) stealthy, furtive look.
example_en: He looked that way with a furtive glance.

definition: a strong, vitreous, translucent ceramic material, made of kaolin, feldspar and quartz or flint; porcelain.
example_en: That shop has beautiful porcelain vessels.

definition: a hair-like lash borne by a cell; cilia.
example_en: The cilia of the cell are clearly visible under the microscope.

definition: the work done by, forced to do by a slave.
example_en: He had to do slave labor in the master's house.

definition: the act of digging or excavating; excavation.
example_en: The workers did the excavation work for the well.

definition: a thin, flat, grooved disc on which a speech, music etc. are recorded; an audio record.
example_en: There are old audio records in that collection.

definition: heaviness as a quality of things; weight.
example: ಈ ಪೆಟ್ಟಿಗೆಯ ವಜನ ಎಷ್ಟಿದೆ ಎಂದು ಕೇಳಿದನು.
example_en: He asked how much the weight of this box was.

definition: the jasmine plant Jasminum sambac of Oleaceae family.
example_en: The jasmine flower bloomed in front of the house.

definition: trodden with the feet.
example_en: Walking on the foot-trodden path is difficult.

definition: the line that separates one country, state, province, etc., from another; frontier line; border.
example_en: The soldiers are standing guard near the border.

definition: a disease of the eye; a trouble in vision.
example: ಅವನಿಗೆ ಕಂಗೇಡು ಎಂಬ ಕಣ್ಣಿನ ರೋಗ ಬಂದಿದೆ.
example_en: He has an eye disease called kangedu.

definition: the quality of being timid, timorous; timidity.
example: ಅವನ ಪಿರಿಕಿತನದಿಂದ ಯಾರೂ ಅವನನ್ನು ಗಂಭೀರವಾಗಿ ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: Because of his timidity no one took him seriously.

definition: a construct a hedge of thorny plants, around a field.
example_en: The farmer built a thorny hedge around the field to protect the crop.

definition: the portion of the body that joins the head the body; the neck.
example_en: A bell was tied around the bullock's neck.

definition: (dial.) across & upside down.
example_en: They have placed the box across and upside down.

definition: a woman who charms, fascinates or captivates by her beauty, grace.
example: ಆ ಸೋಲಕಾರ್ತಿ ತನ್ನ ಸೌಂದರ್ಯದಿಂದ ಎಲ್ಲರನ್ನೂ ಸೆಳೆದಳು.
example_en: That charming woman captivated everyone with her beauty.

definition: (hist.) a monetary coin of gold.
example: ಆ ಕಾಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಮೊಹರಿ ಎಂಬ ಚಿನ್ನದ ನಾಣ್ಯ ಬಳಕೆಯಲ್ಲಿತ್ತು.
example_en: In those days a gold coin called mohari was in use.

definition: the early part of the day; morning.
example_en: It is customary to perform worship in the early morning.

definition: a killing that is outrageously evil or wicked; an abominable murder.
example: ಆ ಕಾಡಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಕೞ್ಗೊಲೆ ನಡೆದು ಜನರು ನಡುಗಿದರು.
example_en: An abominable murder took place in that forest, and the people trembled.

definition: act of extracting juice (from a fruit etc.).
example_en: The priest performed the rite of extracting the juice with devotion.

definition: waste matter expelled from the bowels; excrement; faeces.
example_en: They use cow dung as manure.

definition: absence of orderliness; the state of being deranged.
example_en: In that house, all the things lay in a deranged state.

definition: the quality or state of being abundant, plentiful or copious; copiousness.
example: ಆ ವರ್ಷ ಬೆಳೆಯ ರಾಮರಗಡು ಎಲ್ಲರನ್ನೂ ಸಂತೋಷಪಡಿಸಿತು.
example_en: That year, the copiousness of the harvest delighted everyone.

definition: the time of dissolution of the universe.
example_en: The scriptures describe the time of the universe's dissolution.

definition: to bundle or fill in a large jute bag and tie or sew the mouth.
example_en: They bundled all the clothes into a sack and got ready for the journey.

definition: a petty fight.
example_en: A petty fight took place between the two.

definition: the small finch like bird Passer domesticus of the family Ploceidae, with brown and grey plumage; a house sparrow.
example_en: A house sparrow was sitting on the roof of the house.

definition: the fact of having or being extended over, large area; wideness.
example: ಆ ಮೈದಾನದ ಅರಾಬಿ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಆಶ್ಚರ್ಯ ತಂದಿತು.
example_en: The vastness of that field surprised everyone.

definition: the armpit.
example_en: He came carrying the book under his arm.

definition: a kind of oxide made of the conch shells.
example_en: The physician used conch-shell ash for the medicine.

definition: to relax one's obstinacy, stubbornness.
example_en: Hearing his son's words, the father lets go of his stubbornness.

definition: the act of any of or all of the eleven players of stopping or catching the ball batted by a batsman; the fielding.
example: ಆಟಗಾರ ಚೆಂಡನ್ನು ಹಿಡಿದು ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರರಕ್ಷಣೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಚುರುಕಾಗಿ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: The player caught the ball and fielded briskly.

definition: a silly, playful joke.
example_en: His silly, playful joking made everyone laugh.

definition: an experienced woman; a woman of higher rank, standing or longer in service; a veteran woman.
example: ಆ ಮನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಗುಱುಗೆ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಹೆಂಗಸರಿಗೂ ಮಾರ್ಗದರ್ಶನ ನೀಡುತ್ತಾಳೆ.
example_en: In that household, the veteran woman gives guidance to all the women.

definition: the region of sex-organs.
example_en: The doctor examined the infection of the genital region.

definition: the act of breaking into a house at night to commit theft or other felony; burglary.
example_en: That gang was expert in burglary.

definition: (in comp.) of the colour of pure snow; white.
example_en: She was wearing white clothes.

definition: dried completely; caused to become completely dry.
example_en: The clothes became completely dried in the sun.

definition: a soft food made of plantain.
example_en: The grandmother made plantain food for the children.

definition: to be looted, plundered; to be robbed of.
example_en: The whole village was looted and plundered by the robbers.

definition: the plant (hīla ?).
example_en: The bangaralii plant had grown in the forest.

definition: a physical struggle; a battle; a fight.
example_en: A physical struggle took place between the two soldiers.

definition: anything that is placed down, deposited.
example_en: He picked up the objects that had been placed on the table.

definition: to announce something in public.
example_en: The town crier made the public announcement.

definition: a woman of fishermen community; a fisherwomen.
example: ಆ ಜಾಲಗಾತಿ ಪ್ರತಿದಿನ ಬೆಳಗ್ಗೆ ಮೀನು ಮಾರಲು ಹೋಗುತ್ತಿದ್ದಳು.
example_en: That fisherwoman used to go to sell fish every morning.

definition: the end; conclusion.
example_en: The conclusion of this story was declared right here.

definition: hot air.
example_en: In summer, hot air was striking against the face.

definition: a bed made of thorns.
example: ಸಾಧು ಮುಳುವಸೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಮಲಗಿ ತಪಸ್ಸು ಮಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: The sage did penance lying on a bed of thorns.

definition: a female dancer.
example_en: The female dancer performed a dance at the festival.

definition: lithology - a) the science of rocks as mineral masses; b) the department of science concerned with calculi.
example: ಅಶ್ಮರೀಶಾಸ್ತ್ರ ಬಂಡೆ ಮತ್ತು ಮೂತ್ರಪಿಂಡದ ಕಲ್ಲುಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಅಧ್ಯಯನ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: Lithology studies rocks and, in medicine, calculi.

definition: wind blowing from below.
example_en: The wind blowing from below touched his body and he felt cold.

definition: a single eye.
example_en: Only a single eye was left for him after the accident.

definition: a looting of other's goods, valuables, etc. secretly.
example_en: His jewels were lost through a secret looting at night.

definition: the dwelling place or retreat.
example_en: He built a dwelling place for himself in the forest.

definition: to anticipate (eagerly); to look forward to; to be anxiously waiting for.
example_en: The mother was eagerly looking forward to her son's arrival in the village.

definition: a firm, motionless position.
example_en: Out of fear he stood in a firm, motionless position.

definition: to scatter things here and there; to strew in a disorderly manner.
example: ಅವನು ಬಟ್ಟೆಗಳನ್ನು ಸಿಱುಂಬಳಾಡಿ ನೆಲದ ಮೇಲೆ ಬಿಟ್ಟನು.
example_en: He strewed the clothes in disorder on the floor.

definition: the quality of being ancient or old; antiquity.
example: ಆ ಕೋಟೆಯ ಹಳಕೆಯನ್ನು ಇತಿಹಾಸಕಾರರು ಅಧ್ಯಯನ ಮಾಡಿದರು.
example_en: Historians studied the antiquity of that fort.

definition: a man having moral, religious or social blemish, guilt, taint, etc.
example: ಆ ಕಳಂಕಿತ ಮನುಷ್ಯನನ್ನು ಜನರು ದೂರ ಇಟ್ಟರು.
example_en: People kept away from that man with a moral blemish.

definition: to cause to pour (a liquid) freely down.
example_en: He had the worker pour water into the vessel.

definition: the plant Holcus sorghum.
example_en: The farmers grew the sorghum crop in the field.

definition: to include within; to consist of.
example_en: This book consists of many lessons.

definition: (in erotics) a kind or mode in sexual union.
example: ಆ ಪ್ರಬೋಧಿತ ರೀತಿಯನ್ನು ಪುರಾತನ ಗ್ರಂಥದಲ್ಲಿ ವಿವರಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ.
example_en: That mode of sexual union is described in the ancient text.

definition: to make merriment; to take pleasure in; to enjoy.
example_en: The children played and made merry at the festival.

definition: to hold or seize with the hand.
example_en: The teacher held the disciple's hand and guided him.

definition: a decorated pot worshipped in marriages.
example_en: The bride sat in front of the decorated pot.

definition: based on or involving a system; systematic.
example_en: This plan has been formed in a systematic manner.

definition: the plant Atlantia monophylla (= Limonia monophylla) of Rutaceae family.
example_en: There are wild-lime plants at the foot of the hill.

definition: a single molecule.
example: ಈ ಪ್ರಯೋಗದಲ್ಲಿ ಏಕಕಣದ ರಚನೆಯನ್ನು ಅಧ್ಯಯನ ಮಾಡಿದರು.
example_en: In this experiment, they studied the structure of a single molecule.

definition: to cause to join, unit together.
example_en: They tried to join the two groups together.

definition: to be or become cautious.
example_en: One should be cautious while working near fire.

definition: fat; thick; stout.
example: ಆ ಮನುಷ್ಯನ ಗಾತ್ರ ದೇಹ ಎಲ್ಲರ ಗಮನ ಸೆಳೆಯಿತು.
example_en: That man's stout body drew everyone's attention.

definition: neatness; tidiness; orderliness.
example_en: There is neatness in her house.

definition: to convey from one place to another (esp. from a difficult situation).
example_en: The boatman conveyed the drowning people to safety.

definition: a moulded item.
example_en: That doll was a moulded item.

definition: a woman who has expert knowledge and keen discrimination in the field of music, fine arts or in matters of taste; a connoisseur.
example: ಭಾವುಕೆಯಾದ ಅವಳು ಸಂಗೀತದ ಸೂಕ್ಷ್ಮಗಳನ್ನು ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿ ಅರಿತಿದ್ದಾಳೆ.
example_en: Being a connoisseur, she understands the finer points of music well.

definition: the planet that we live on; terrestrial globe; the earth.
example_en: The sun illuminates the earth.

definition: that which is performed as a traditional ritual, believed to be a means of obtaining heaven or absolution.
example_en: The priests performed the traditional ritual.

definition: to cause or make another wait for.
example_en: He made me wait at the door.

definition: the science and art of political government; political science.
example: ಅವನು ನೃಪಧರ್ಮ ದಲ್ಲಿ ಆಳವಾದ ಜ್ಞಾನ ಹೊಂದಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: He had deep knowledge of political science.

definition: a peeping in.
example_en: The child took a peep in from the door.

definition: a cloth, taurpaulin, etc. used to cover something.
example_en: When it rained, they covered the cart with a tarpaulin.

definition: a bitter, crystalline alkaloid, extracted from cinchona (Cinchona succirubra) bark; quinine.
example_en: For the fever the doctor gave a quinine tablet.

definition: an enveloping darkness.
example_en: In the enveloping darkness he stood unable to see the way.

definition: (rhet.) that which is unpleasant or grating to the ears; cacophony.
example_en: That sound was cacophonous and hurt the ears.

definition: any of the oils manually extracted from oil seeds.
example_en: The villagers use hand-pressed oil for cooking.

definition: a bad or unsuitable match; mismatch.
example_en: The mismatch in the two people's natures made the marriage difficult.

definition: the egret Egretta garzetta of Ciconliformes of Ardeidae family, with long, black bill and legs, and white or dull-white plumes, that lives by rivers, ponds, and in marshy areas.
example: ಬಲಾಹಕ ಕೆರೆಯ ದಡದಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಂತು ಮೀನು ಹಿಡಿಯುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The egret stood on the bank of the pond and caught fish.

definition: an instruction order, etc, restraining (another person) from going beyond or restricting from coming in or going out, of a expressed limit.
example_en: The military officer had a restriction order imposed at the border.

definition: a kitchen garden.
example: ಅಡುಗೆಗಾಗಿ ಅವನು ಮನೆಯ ಹಿಂದೆ ಕುಟಪ ಬೆಳೆಸಿದನು.
example_en: He grew a kitchen garden behind the house for cooking.

definition: (a baby) to be delivered by her mother.
example_en: That mother was delivered of her baby in the hospital.

definition: the art, practice or profession of an acrobat.
example_en: He learned the profession of an acrobat for years.

definition: to say something in opposition; to object; to express dissentience, objection in strong words; to object; to take exception.
example_en: He strongly objected to that decision.

definition: to clear (an area) of weeds; to weed out.
example_en: The farmers weed out the field in the morning.

definition: a small grenade thrown by hand and exploded by a timed fuse or by impact; a hand grenade.
example_en: The soldier threw a hand grenade.

definition: absence of coherence in speech or thought.
example_en: The incoherence in his speech was clearly evident.

definition: a man who is hired for some specific job.
example_en: That hired worker came for the household job.

definition: a wire or strand of wires having small pieces of sharply pointed wire twisted around it at short intervals, used chiefly for fencing to keep out trespassers, etc.; a barbed-wire.
example_en: They put up a barbed-wire fence around the field.

definition: without reason, judgement, forethought; capriciously.
example_en: He spoke capriciously and angered everyone.

definition: of or related to a muslim emperor or his rule.
example_en: Grand buildings were constructed under the emperor's rule.

definition: a man who habitually lies; a lier.
example: ಊರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಅವನನ್ನು ಸಟೆಗ ಎಂದು ಕರೆಯುತ್ತಿದ್ದರು.
example_en: Everyone in the village called him a habitual liar.

definition: the act or manner of flying of birds through space.
example_en: The children were delighted to watch the birds' flight through the sky.

definition: eight times the quantity or number.
example: ಈ ಬೆಳೆ ಕಳೆದ ವರ್ಷಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಎಣ್ಮಡಿ ಆಗಿದೆ.
example_en: This crop has become eight times as much as last year.

definition: the lower surface of a human foot; the sole.
example_en: A thorn pricked the sole of the foot and it hurt.

definition: an enlargement of the thyroid gland, often visible as a swelling in the lower part of the front of the neck; goitre.
example_en: She had had a goitre since childhood.

definition: to cover with (a cloth, veil, etc.).
example_en: He covered the corpse with a white cloth.

definition: separated from one's beloved, sweetehart.
example_en: Separated from her beloved, she became distressed as a lovelorn woman.

definition: (laughing) with a hoarse sound.
example: ಅವನ ಕೆಟ್ಟ ಜೋಕ್ ಕೇಳಿ ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಗಹಗಹನೆ ನಕ್ಕರು.
example_en: Everyone laughed hoarsely at his bad joke.

definition: a Vedic hymn.
example_en: The priest chanted the Vedic hymn during the worship.

definition: (the place) to become dry.
example_en: The lake's edge became dry due to the sun.

definition: a man who is able to compete with, fight or struggle against one's opponent competently.
example_en: He had no one to compete with in the competition.

definition: the plant Nardostachys jatamansi, of Valerianaceae family, that yields a fragrant ointment used in ancient times; spikenard.
example_en: The physicians prepared fragrant oil from spikenard.

definition: a mango fruit.
example_en: The mango fruit fell down from the tree.

definition: a phobic fear of fire; pyrophobia.
example_en: A person with pyrophobia is afraid when he sees fire.

definition: half the body.
example_en: Half of his body was in pain after the accident.

definition: the thread spread crosswise on the loom.
example_en: The weaver carefully arranged the crosswise thread on the loom.

definition: the analysis of an ore, alloy, etc. to determine the nature, proportion or purity of the ingredients; assay.
example: ವಿಜ್ಞಾನಿಗಳು ಲೋಹಪರೀಕ್ಷೆ ನಡೆಸಿ ಚಿನ್ನದ ಶುದ್ಧತೆ ಪತ್ತೆಹಚ್ಚಿದರು.
example_en: The scientists conducted an assay and determined the gold's purity.

definition: a male goose; a gander.
example: ಕೊಳದಲ್ಲಿ ವರಟ ಹೆಣ್ಣು ಹಂಸೆಯ ಸುತ್ತ ತಿರುಗುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The gander was moving around the female swan in the pond.

definition: a shifting of one's position; the act or process of moving; movement.
example: ಕೆಲಸಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಅವರ ಪರಿಯಟಣ ಬೇರೆ ಊರಿಗೆ ಆಯಿತು.
example_en: Their shift for work took place to another town.

definition: a transparent, flawless or almost flawless piece of a pure or nearly pure, extremely hard form of carbon, naturally crystallised in the isometric system, valued as a precious gem; diamond.
example_en: There was a shining diamond in her ring.

definition: a discharging or removing or being discharged or removed from office or service, etc.; dismissal; removal.
example_en: He was removed from office due to dereliction of duty.

definition: to move (something) from where it is; to transfer, carry away; to remove.
example_en: She carried away the goods.

definition: the active principle that burns giving out heat and light; fire.
example_en: Fire caught in the forest and the trees were burnt.

definition: that which is bound, tied or bundled.
example_en: The police examined the bundled/tied objects.

definition: the act or fact of dying; death.
example: ಆ ಹಿರಿಯನ ಮಡಿವು ಇಡೀ ಊರನ್ನು ದುಃಖಕ್ಕೀಡು ಮಾಡಿತು.
example_en: The death of that elder plunged the whole village into grief.

definition: that can be got, obtained; obtainable.
example: ಈ ಪುಸ್ತಕ ಈಗ ಅಂಗಡಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸುಲಭವಾಗಿ ಲಭ್ಯವಿದೆ.
example_en: This book is now easily obtainable in the shop.

definition: an instrument in the form of a graduated semicircle, used for plotting and measuring angles; a protractor.
example_en: The teacher measured the angle with a protractor.

definition: to make feel less sad or disappointed; to comfort; to console; to cheer up in distress; to pacify; to appease.
example_en: The friend consoled the sorrowful companion.

definition: by that time or period; before the end of that period.
example_en: The master said the work must be finished by that period.

definition: (pl.) two teams, parties, groups, etc.
example_en: A competition took place between the two teams.

definition: causing dislike; detestable; disgusting.
example: ಅವನ ವಿರೂಕ್ಷ ನಡತೆ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಅಸಹ್ಯ ಹುಟ್ಟಿಸಿತು.
example_en: His disgusting behaviour repelled everyone.

definition: to cause to bathe after cremating the dead body of a person.
example_en: After the cremation, the priest made everyone bathe.

definition: excessive desire; greediness; covetousnes; gluttony.
example_en: Because of his greediness he lost all his wealth.

definition: any colour that is light, not dark or pale.
example_en: She wore a saree of a light color.

definition: the act or an instance of visiting for seeing, talking, checking, etc.; a visit.
example_en: The farmers came to the office for a meeting with the officer.

definition: to cause (two things, persons, etc.) to hit or knock against, each other by jerking.
example_en: The children knocked two stones against each other and played.

definition: (an insect) to make a hissing or buzzing sound (while flying).
example_en: The beetle buzzed as it flew.

definition: an official who executes the orders of the Court of law, with power to confiscate, attach properties, collect taxes, etc.; a bailiff.
example_en: The bailiff confiscated the property.

definition: the hereditary profession, duty of a village accountant.
example_en: His family has been carrying out the village accountant's hereditary duty for generations.

definition: a coiled snake.
example_en: A coiled snake was seen at the base of that tree.

definition: raw flesh of animals.
example_en: The tiger ate the raw flesh of the deer.

definition: the administration of government through departments and subdivisions managed by sets of appointed officials following an inflexible routine; bureaucracy.
example_en: This work was delayed because of bureaucracy.

definition: (a flower-bud) to expand, blow up; to blossom.
example_en: In the morning sunlight the buds blossomed open.

definition: (fem.) a friend or companion of the bride at a wedding.
example_en: The bride's companion stayed by her side.

definition: a region or country belonging to one's enemy.
example_en: The army entered the enemy's territory.

definition: a channel or pipe for carrying off water, sewage, etc.; a drain.
example_en: Water from the paddy field goes out through the drain.

definition: breathing, in general.
example_en: In yoga, the breathing should be regulated.

definition: a variety in peacock.
example_en: The peacock of the kannavilu variety was dancing in the garden.

definition: a kind of creeper .
example_en: The cāgaṭe creeper had spread all along the fence.

definition: to get (a danger, evil) removed, warded off.
example_en: They performed a ritual and warded off evil from the house.

definition: a reddish first magnitude star in Orion's shoulder.
example_en: The star Ārti was shining in the night sky.

definition: greatness, as of quantity, degree, etc.; muchness.
example: ಆ ಸಂಪತ್ತಿನ ಬಹುತೆ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಆಶ್ಚರ್ಯ ತಂದಿತು.
example_en: The muchness of that wealth surprised everyone.

definition: a drop or droplet of water.
example_en: A drop of water shone like a pearl on the leaf.

definition: to stir, beat or shake (milk or cream) in a churn; to churn.
example: ಅವಳು ಪ್ರತಿದಿನ ಬೆಳಗ್ಗೆ ಹಾಲನ್ನು ಆಲೋಡನಂಗೆಯ್ದು ಬೆಣ್ಣೆ ತೆಗೆಯುತ್ತಿದ್ದಳು.
example_en: She used to churn the milk every morning and extract butter.

definition: a mark left by the shod or unshod foot, as in earth or sand; a footprint.
example_en: The footprint had formed clearly in the snow.

definition: (dial.) an insect of the cricket family that burrows through soft mud; mole-cricket.
example_en: The mole-cricket made a tunnel in the wet soil.

definition: a small fixed wheel, sometimes turning in a block, with a grooved rim in which a rope or chain runs, as to raise a weight attached at one end by pulling on the other end; a pulley.
example_en: The pulley of that well was old.

definition: a pregnant woman.
example_en: The pregnant woman went to the hospital for a checkup.

definition: perception of something objectively existing in such a way as to cause mis-interpretation of its actual nature; illusion.
example_en: An illusion of water appears in the desert.

definition: a short, lyric poem or song.
example_en: The poet wrote a beautiful short lyric poem.

definition: a place where goods are sold and bought; a market.
example_en: In the morning, the market was full of vegetables.

definition: the auspicious moment of the day-break.
example_en: At the auspicious moment of daybreak, the birds were singing.

definition: a laying or leaving aside; abandoning; suspension.
example_en: He abandoned politics.

definition: to insert with force; to stuff in.
example_en: She stuffed the cloth into the bag.

definition: something offered or given to the winner of a contest; a prize.
example_en: They gave a prize to the winner of the competition.

definition: as a result of this or that; for this or that reason; consequently; therefore; hence.
example: ಅವನು ಸುಳ್ಳು ಹೇಳಿದನು, ಆದಕಾರಣ ಯಾರೂ ನಂಬಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: He told a lie, therefore no one believed him.

definition: to become ripe; to ripen.
example_en: The bananas have ripened and are ready to eat.

definition: that which is stamped with a seal, signet, etc.
example_en: That letter was stamped with the government seal.

definition: a bad writing.
example: ಆ ಪತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ದುರ್ಲಿಖಿತ ಅಕ್ಷರಗಳು ಓದಲು ಕಷ್ಟವಾಗಿದ್ದವು.
example_en: The bad writing in that letter was hard to read.

definition: a man addicted to opium; an opium-addict.
example: ಆ ಅಫೀಮುಖೋರ ದಿನಕ್ಕೆ ಹಲವು ಬಾರಿ ಮಾದಕ ವಸ್ತು ಬಳಸುತ್ತಿದ್ದ.
example_en: That opium-addict used the drug several times a day.

definition: kissed; caressed with the lips.
example: ತಾಯಿ ತನ್ನ ಚುಂಬಿತ ಮಗುವನ್ನು ಪ್ರೀತಿಯಿಂದ ನೋಡಿದಳು.
example_en: The mother lovingly looked at her kissed child.

definition: any of the five main divisions of geologic time.
example_en: Scientists are researching the geological eras.

definition: to be charmed greatly; to enchanted.
example_en: Watching the dance, all the people were greatly enchanted.

definition: any of several soft-furred, large-eared, rodentlike burrowing mammals of the family Leporidae, (order Lagomorpha) having a divided upper lip and long hind legs; a rabbit.
example_en: The rabbit leapt out of the bush and ran.

definition: closed; shut.
example_en: The door was shut; no one was inside.

definition: to come jumpingly, flyingly; to come rushingly and eagerly.
example_en: The children came rushing eagerly to the playground.

definition: a kind of deadly poison.
example_en: The hunter smeared a deadly poison on the arrow.

definition: decorated; made-up; beautified.
example_en: The bride came to the stage all decorated and made-up.

definition: the vine Piper caninum of Piperaceae family.
example_en: The Piper caninum vine climbs up a tree and grows.

definition: that which is smeared, rubbed or daubed well with.
example_en: The wall was well smeared with oil.

definition: the mental disorder characterised by apparent perception of sights that are not actually present or being inspired by false conceptions or fancy imaginations.
example: ಅವನಿಗೆ ಮರುಳು ಹಿಡಿದಿದೆ ಎಂದು ಜನ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: People say he is afflicted with hallucination.

definition: to greatly rejoice; to be delighted.
example_en: Receiving that prize, he greatly rejoiced.

definition: unavoidable - a) that cannot be avoided; inevitable; b) that cannot be voided or nullified.
example_en: Death is an unavoidable truth.

definition: one of the men who heralds by turn; an official herald.
example_en: That herald was on night-watch duty by turn.

definition: a thin, horny plate, consisting of modified epidermis, growing on the upper side of the end of a finger or toe; a nail.
example_en: The nail on the finger had grown and needed to be cut.

definition: a variety of crow with slightly reddish plumage.
example_en: The reddish crow was sitting on the branch of the tree.

definition: any person practicing specious reasoning; a sophist.
example_en: No one believed that sophist's words.

definition: a kind of curry made with the flesh of chicken.
example_en: The chicken curry was aromatic in the kitchen.

definition: a swollen part of the body; swelling.
example_en: A swelling occurred on the finger after the injury.

definition: to give the booty to; to hand over the spoils to.
example_en: The soldiers handed over the spoils to the defeated king.

definition: the world of gods; heaven.
example_en: In mythology, dyuloka means the world of gods.

definition: a note written as an aid to remember (something); a reminder note.
example_en: He wrote down the list of tasks as a reminder note.

definition: a rustic taste.
example: ಅವನ ಮಾತಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಇನ್ನೂ ಗಾವರಸ ಎದ್ದು ಕಾಣುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: A rustic taste was still evident in his speech.

definition: the diver bird, water crow.
example_en: The water crow was sitting at the edge of the pond.

definition: a raised path, paved with stone, passing through a marsh; a causeway.
example_en: They have built a causeway across the marshy area.

definition: sodium chloride, NaCl, a white, crystalline substance with a characteristic taste, found in natural beds, in sea water, etc., and used for seasoning and preserving foods, etc.; (common) salt.
example_en: The salt became a little too much for the dish.

definition: a Muslim placethat usu. has a minaret; a mosque.
example_en: That mosque's minaret is tall.

definition: a making of harsh sounds in breathing, while asleep as caused by vibration of the soft palate usu. with the mouth open; the act or sound of snoring.
example_en: The grandson woke up hearing his grandfather's snoring.

definition: produced or effected by a cause.
example_en: This event was a result produced by a specific cause.

definition: the act of killing; slaughter.
example_en: The slaughter of soldiers in the war was terrible.

definition: a whip with leather lash.
example_en: The farmer struck the oxen with the leather-lashed whip.

definition: a hot, spicy powder added to pappaḍa.
example_en: Sprinkle the spicy powder on the pappad and eat it.

definition: rays of heat; hot rays (as of the sun).
example_en: The hot rays were burning the skin.

definition: to feel sorry for or feel for; to sympathise with; to commiserate or be sorry for; to condole; to be sympathetic.
example_en: Hearing his friend's troubles, he felt deeply sorry for him.

definition: (wind) to blow towards.
example: ಸಂಜೆಯಾಗುತ್ತಲೇ ಗಾಳಿಯು ಊರಿನ ಕಡೆಗೆ ಸುೞಿವರ್ ಪ್ರಾರಂಭಿಸಿತು.
example_en: As evening fell, the wind began to blow towards the village.

definition: a heap of sand; a dune.
example_en: The children were playing on the sand dune.

definition: in a straightforward manner; straightly.
example_en: She answered the question in a straightforward manner.

definition: deranged, uncombed hair.
example: ಮಗುವಿನ ಕೆದರ್ಗೂದಲ್ ನೋಡಿ ತಾಯಿ ನಗುತ್ತಾ ಬಾಚಿದಳು.
example_en: Seeing the child's uncombed hair, the mother laughed and combed it.

definition: ānjanēya, an important character in the epic Rāmāyaṇa.
example: ಹನುಮನು ರಾಮನಿಗೆ ತನ್ನ ಪ್ರಾಣದಷ್ಟೇ ಪ್ರಿಯನಾದ ಸೇವಕನು.
example_en: Hanuman is a servant dearer to Rama than his own life.

definition: a sore on the finger joint; knuckle-sore.
example_en: He got a knuckle-sore from writing.

definition: clothes to be worn in bed, as paijamas; night clothes.
example: ರಾತ್ರಿ ಮಲಗುವ ಮೊದಲು ಅವನು ಇರುಳುಡುಪು ಧರಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: Before sleeping at night he put on his night clothes.

definition: the state or quality of being in agreement; correspondence; harmony.
example_en: Harmony (a matching agreement) was established between the two parties.

definition: to draw a picture.
example_en: That artist drew a picture on the wall.

definition: tears of joy.
example: ಮಗ ಮನೆಗೆ ಬಂದಾಗ ತಾಯಿಯ ಕಣ್ಣಲ್ಲಿ ಸಂತಸಗಂಬನಿ ಸುರಿಯಿತು.
example_en: Tears of joy flowed from the mother's eyes when her son came home.

definition: the cutting edge of a sword.
example_en: The cutting edge of that sword was very sharp.

definition: that which is absolutely necessary; an essential thing.
example_en: Water is considered an essential thing for life.

definition: a killing by cutting the throat.
example_en: The whole village was shocked by that cruel throat-cutting killing.

definition: the palm tree Pinanga dicksonii (= Areca dicksonii) of Arecaceae family.
example: ಕಡಲತೀರದ ಕಾಡಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಜಂಡರಿಗೆ ಮರಗಳು ಎತ್ತರವಾಗಿ ಬೆಳೆದಿದ್ದವು.
example_en: The jandarige palm trees grew tall in the coastal forest.

definition: the act of sowing seeds in the ground.
example_en: The farmer did the sowing of seeds in the field.

definition: a bi-lingual or multi-lingual dictionary of cognate languages.
example_en: Kannada-Tamil scholars compiled that dictionary of cognate languages.

definition: to make equal; to equal.
example_en: He tried to make both shares equal.

definition: agricultural crop grown or as standing on a field.
example: ಹೊಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಈ ವರ್ಷ ಪೀಕು ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿ ಬೆಳೆದಿದೆ.
example_en: The crop has grown well in the field this year.

definition: the front part of the neck.
example_en: Her throat hurts a lot.

definition: a man who kills another or others; a murderer; a killer.
example_en: The police arrested the murderer.

definition: a hymn praising a deity or a venerable person.
example_en: The priests recited a hymn in praise of the goddess.

definition: a heavy, thrusting blow with the fist; a punch.
example_en: He gave his opponent a heavy punch in the wrestling match.

definition: a rich man.
example_en: The rich man of the town got a new temple built.

definition: the act of shivering, a shivering movement; trembling.
example_en: Due to the cold, a shivering began in him.

definition: a coagulated mass.
example: ಹಾಲು ಕಾಯಿಸಿದಾಗ ಅದರ ಮೇಲೆ ಹೆರೆ ಕಟ್ಟಿತು.
example_en: When the milk was boiled, a coagulated layer formed on top of it.

definition: the portion of the human body above the neck.
example_en: He was frightened when he saw the severed head.

definition: lack of concord; discord; dissension; conflict.
example_en: Discord grew between the two brothers.

definition: a thin, valve-like, cartilaginous structure that covers the glottis during swallowing, preventing the entrance of food and drink into the larynx; the epiglottis.
example_en: The epiglottis closes the throat while swallowing food.

definition: (in dramatics) a heroine who first refuses to please her hero and later repents for her behaviour; (one of the eight kinds of heroines).
example_en: She performed the role of the abhisandhike heroine well in the drama.

definition: to translate into another language.
example_en: He translated the English book into Kannada.

definition: one who complaints or appeals; a complainant; a plaintiff.
example: ಅಹವಾಲುದಾರ ನ್ಯಾಯಾಲಯದ ಮುಂದೆ ತನ್ನ ದೂರು ಸಲ್ಲಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: The complainant submitted his complaint before the court.

definition: the act of establishing oneself at a place (as a resident).
example: ಅವನು ಈ ಊರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಶಾಶ್ವತ ನಿಲ್ಗೆ ಮಾಡಿಕೊಂಡನು.
example_en: He established permanent residence in this town.

definition: a shallow river that can be crossed by wading; a fordable river.
example: ಕಾಲ್ದೊಱೆ ಆಳವಿಲ್ಲದೆ ಇದ್ದುದರಿಂದ ನಾವು ಅದನ್ನು ದಾಟಿದೆವು.
example_en: Since the fordable river was not deep, we crossed it.

definition: the state of being satisfied; the feeling of satisfaction; gratification.
example: ಊಟ ಮಾಡಿದ ಮೇಲೆ ಅವನಿಗೆ ದಣಿವು ಆಯಿತು.
example_en: After eating, he felt a sense of satisfaction.

definition: a portable optical device, providing good depth effect, consisting of two small telescopes fitted together side by side, each telescope having two prisms between the eyepiece and objective for erecting the image; a pair of binoculars.
example: ದೂರದ ಪಕ್ಷಿಗಳನ್ನು ನೋಡಲು ನಾನು ಚೀನಿಕೊಳವೆಯನ್ನು ಬಳಸಿದೆ.
example_en: I used binoculars to watch the birds from a distance.

definition: to deceive by trickery; to fool; to cheat.
example_en: The cheat deceived the people.

definition: a horse-rider.
example_en: That horse-rider fought valiantly in the battle.

definition: a medicinal substance made using five ingredients.
example_en: The doctor advised the patient to take panchananarasa medicine.

definition: a falling short; failure; unsuccessfulness; non-accomplishment.
example: ಸರಿಯಾದ ಯೋಜನೆ ಇಲ್ಲದ ಕಾರಣ ಕೆಲಸದಲ್ಲಿ ಅಕರಣಿ ಉಂಟಾಯಿತು.
example_en: Because there was no proper plan, the work ended in failure.

definition: cutting; able to cut or pierce easily and effectively; sharp; keen; acute.
example_en: The blade of this sword is very sharp.

definition: the power or practices of witches; black magic; sorcery; witchcraft.
example_en: She had learnt witchcraft and used to frighten people.

definition: the quality of cheating; fraudulent or deceitful nature.
example_en: Everyone knew about his deceitful nature.

definition: a mark; a sign.
example_en: The archer aimed at the target and shot the arrow.

definition: a man who has accomplished an aim or object succcessfully.
example: ಆ ಯುವಕ ತನ್ನ ಗುರಿ ಸಾಧಿಸಿ ಸಿದ್ಧಾರ್ಥನಾದನು.
example_en: That young man achieved his goal and became successful.

definition: the inner apartment of a house.
example_en: The guests were not taken into the inner apartment of the house.

definition: the royal insignia, used to authenticate the documents of the state.
example_en: The royal insignia was stamped on the king's orders.

definition: afterwards; subsequently.
example_en: The cold increased afterwards, following the sunset.

definition: a blind man.
example_en: That blind man walked with the help of a stick.

definition: to become or be made, foul, dirty or unclean; to be polluted; to be debased.
example_en: The air becomes polluted due to chemicals.

definition: to cause to grow opulently; to make fat; to fatten.
example: ರೈತನು ಕರುಗಳನ್ನು ಕೊರ್ವಿಸಲು ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಮೇವು ಕೊಟ್ಟನು.
example_en: The farmer gave more fodder to fatten the calves.

definition: to tear or pull out by the roots; to uproot.
example_en: He uprooted the plant along with its roots.

definition: to have a stain, black spot on.
example_en: This cloth got a stain from the oil.

definition: a counter-weight used to offset the weight of the container while weighing something, esp. a liquid.
example: ಎಣ್ಣೆ ತೂಕ ಮಾಡುವಾಗ ಅಂಗಡಿಯವನು ದಡವನ್ನು ಬಳಸಿದನು.
example_en: While weighing the oil, the shopkeeper used a counter-weight.

definition: a symbol or word or a group of either of these, showing how many or which one in a series; a (cardinal) number.
example_en: I noted down the number of his house.

definition: to become tasteless; to lose (one's original) taste.
example_en: The curry left in the sun became tasteless.

definition: a woven fabric; a cloth.
example_en: Weavers weave this fabric.

definition: food that is put in cans, boxes, etc. and ready to eat.
example_en: He carried packed ready food along during the journey.

definition: (n.) a legal case registered in a court of law.
example: ಆ ಜಮೀನಿನ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಮುಕದಮಿ ಇನ್ನೂ ನ್ಯಾಯಾಲಯದಲ್ಲಿದೆ.
example_en: The legal case regarding that land is still in the court.

definition: to bite with the teeth, esp. to grind with the molar teeth.
example_en: The cow slowly chewed the grass with its molar teeth.

definition: the act of deceiving; the state of being deceived; deception.
example_en: His deception was eventually revealed to everyone.

definition: a plant (akin to oleander ?).
example_en: A heggaṇigalu plant had grown in the garden fence.

definition: a screen made by weaving thin strips of bamboo, used as a partition wall, screen, etc.
example_en: They had put up a bamboo screen on the veranda.

definition: the act of playing a percussion instrument rhythmically with one's hands or a stick or sticks.
example_en: The rhythmic drumming during the festival attracted everyone.

definition: a fine misty rain; drizzle.
example_en: A fine drizzle was falling in the early morning.

definition: understood, realised well.
example_en: The teacher's teaching was well understood by him.

definition: to become attractive, lovely, charming.
example_en: Her face became charming like a flower.

definition: the blaze of a fire; flame.
example_en: The blaze of fire engulfed the house.

definition: a colour.
example_en: The colour of this cloth is very attractive.

definition: a plant that lives on or in another plant and obtains nutriment from the later.
example: ಬಂದನಿಕೆ ಗಿಡವು ಆತಿಥೇಯ ಗಿಡದಿಂದ ನೀರು ಹೀರುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The parasitic plant sucks water from the host plant.

definition: appropriation (of public money, resources) for personal, incorrect or dishonest use; misappropriation.
example: ಆ ಅಧಿಕಾರಿ ಸರ್ಕಾರಿ ಹಣದ ಅಫರಾತಫರಾ ಮಾಡಿದ.
example_en: That officer misappropriated the government money.

definition: a place where old, weak or protectionless cattle are given protection and shelter.
example: ಆ ಪಾಂಜರಪೋಳದಲ್ಲಿ ವೃದ್ಧ ಪ್ರಾಣಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಆಶ್ರಯ ನೀಡುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: Old animals are given shelter in that cattle shelter.

definition: the biennial plant Daucus carota (var. sativa) of Apiaceae family, with fernlike leaves and compound umbels of white flowers, usu. with one red flower in the centre; carrot.
example_en: Mother chopped carrot for the salad.

definition: a man who loves (a woman); a lover.
example: ಆಕೆಯ ಕೂರ್ಪ ಪ್ರತಿ ದಿನ ಅವಳ ಬಳಿಗೆ ಬರುತ್ತಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: Her lover used to come to her every day.

definition: perceptible by the eyes.
example_en: That change of colours was perceptible by the eyes.

definition: absence of doubts; certainty.
example_en: I have no doubt about his honesty.

definition: in literary composition, a kind of fault of not maintaining the order started with.
example: ಈ ಕಥೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅಕ್ರಮ ಎಂಬ ದೋಷ ಕಂಡುಬರುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: In this story, the fault called akrama is found.

definition: a veil used (by women) to cover the face.
example_en: The women wore face veils and protected themselves from the sun.

definition: a greedy, covetous man.
example: ಆ ಲುಬ್ಧ ಯಾರಿಗೂ ಒಂದು ರೂಪಾಯಿ ಕೊಡುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: That miser does not give even a rupee to anyone.

definition: an image or picture made by photography or painting; a photograph.
example: ಗೋಡೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಒಂದು ಹಳೆಯ ಪಠ ತೂಗುಹಾಕಿದ್ದರು.
example_en: An old photograph was hung on the wall.

definition: intense anger; rage; fury.
example: ಅವಮಾನದಿಂದ ಅವನ ಮನದಲ್ಲಿ ಕನಪು ಉಕ್ಕಿ ಬಂತು.
example_en: Because of the insult, fury welled up in his mind.

definition: that part of a garment which covers, encircles or is nearest the neck; collar.
example_en: The collar of that shirt was very beautiful.

definition: free from dirt, contamination, impurities, etc.; clean.
example_en: This water is completely free from impurities.

definition: the lowest level, position.
example_en: His position in that group was the lowest level.

definition: that is very common or ordinary.
example_en: Such mistakes have now become very common matters.

definition: the act, fact of drinking spirituous liquors by several persons together.
example: ಸ್ನೇಹಿತರು ರಾತ್ರಿ ಗೋಷ್ಠಿಕೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸೇರಿ ಮದ್ಯ ಸೇವಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: The friends gathered at night and drank liquor together.

definition: a singing.
example_en: Her singing captivated everyone's mind.

definition: God's grace.
example_en: Without God's grace, no task will succeed.

definition: a liquid in which red gram (pulse of Cajanus indicus, a leguminous plant) or any other pulse is boiled without spices but strained, (prescribed esp. for patients to have it with boiled rice); a soup-like dish.
example: ಅಜ್ಜಿ ರೋಗಿಗೆ ಬಿಸಿ ಕಟ್ಟು ಮಾಡಿ ಕೊಟ್ಟಳು.
example_en: Grandmother made and gave hot pulse-soup to the patient.

definition: small - a) little in size, esp. when compared with others of the same kind; not large or big; limited in size; b) of slight intensity; of limited degree or scope.
example: ಈ ಚೀಲ ಆ ಚೀಲಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಚಿಕ್ಕ ಗಾತ್ರದ್ದು.
example_en: This bag is smaller in size than that bag.

definition: (mus.) a mode.
example: ಗಾಯಕ ಆ ಹಾಡನ್ನು ಹೊಸ ಪಂತುವಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಹಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: The singer sang that song in a new musical mode.

definition: a smiling face.
example_en: Everyone became happy seeing her smiling face.

definition: the advanced years in human life; old-age.
example_en: In his old age, he is living peacefully with his children.

definition: a person who steers a ship or boat; a helmsman; a steersman.
example_en: The helmsman steered the boat safely even in the storm.

definition: a tooth on the surface of which a thin film containing mucin, bacteria, etc. is formed; a plaque-tooth.
example: ಈ ಕೀನಿವಲ್ ಹಲ್ಲಿನ ಮೇಲೆ ಬಿಳಿಯ ಪೊರೆ ಕಟ್ಟಿಕೊಂಡಿದೆ.
example_en: A white film has formed on this plaque-tooth.

definition: excessive or deep love or affection.
example_en: The mother had deep affection for her child.

definition: a person having special knowledge of entomology; an entomologist.
example: ಆ ಕೀಟವಿಜ್ಞಾನಿ ಜೀರುಂಡೆಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಸಂಶೋಧನೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದಾನೆ.
example_en: That entomologist is researching beetles.

definition: the act of sitting; the condition of being seated.
example_en: His sitting continued for a long time.

definition: something given to show friendship, affection, support, etc.; a present; a gift; a grant of land, towns, etc. as perpetuity.
example: ರಾಜ ಕವಿಗೆ ಭೂಮಿಯನ್ನು ಇನಾಂ ಆಗಿ ನೀಡಿದನು.
example_en: The king gave land as a gift to the poet.

definition: to be stuck to; to adhere to; to be fixed to.
example: ಗೋಡೆಗೆ ಬಣ್ಣ ಹಚ್ಚಿದಾಗ ಕೈಗೆ ಬಟ್ಟೆ ಅಂಟರುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: When paint is applied to the wall, cloth sticks to the hand.

definition: henceforth; hereafter.
example_en: Henceforth I will not make this mistake.

definition: the bony framework of the human head; skull.
example_en: The archaeologists found an old skull.

definition: weak sight.
example_en: As he grew old, his sight became weak.

definition: wet, soggy earth; mire.
example_en: After the rain, the field was full of mire.

definition: causing (sharp) pain; painfully.
example_en: The thorn pricked the foot painfully.

definition: (fem.) one of several persons who sing or play music in chorus.
example: ಮೇಳಗಾರ್ತಿ ಮಧುರವಾಗಿ ಹಾಡಿ ಎಲ್ಲರ ಮನ ಗೆದ್ದಳು.
example_en: The chorus singer sang sweetly and won everyone's heart.

definition: ability to reason; intellect; wisdom.
example_en: That scholar had immense wisdom.

definition: a violent, reckless, destructive behaviour; rampage.
example_en: The drunkards created a rampage on the road.

definition: a period of temporary cessation; a pause; interval.
example: ಎರಡು ಸಭೆಗಳ ನಡುವೆ ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ವ್ಯವಧಾನ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: There was a brief pause between the two meetings.

definition: (madness, craziness, hysteria, etc. ) to be provoked, incited greatly.
example: ಆ ಘಟನೆಯಿಂದ ಅವನಲ್ಲಿ ಮರುಳ್ಮಸಗಿ ಕೋಪ ಉಂಟಾಯಿತು.
example_en: That incident greatly incited madness and anger in him.

definition: the first pregnancy (of a woman).
example_en: This is her first pregnancy, and everyone is joyful.

definition: the physical suffering or mental agony.
example_en: She did not tell anyone about her suffering.

definition: to have intense dislike; to loathe.
example_en: She loathes the sight of that food.

definition: to attack with a military force.
example: ರಾಜನ ಸೈನ್ಯ ಬೆಳಗಿನ ಜಾವ ಶತ್ರುಗಳ ಮೇಲೆ ಧಾಳಿವರಿಯಿತು.
example_en: The king's army attacked the enemies at dawn with its military force.

definition: a short extract from a book, film, piece of music, etc.; for the purpose of reference, example etc.; excerption.
example: ಪ್ರಬಂಧಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಅವಳು ಕಾದಂಬರಿಯಿಂದ ಒಂದು ಎತ್ತಿಕೆಯನ್ನು ಆರಿಸಿದಳು.
example_en: She chose an excerpt from the novel for her essay.

definition: betrayal of trust, faith or allegiance; treachery; perfidy; disloyalty; treason.
example_en: His friend's betrayal hurt him a great deal.

definition: to keep, place in front.
example_en: The chairman placed the report before the meeting.

definition: (dial.) a trough for holding kitchen waste-water.
example_en: The dirty water from the kitchen should be poured into the trough.

definition: a wooden vessel, bucket, trough, etc.
example_en: The farmer filled water in the wooden bucket.

definition: the influence of time.
example_en: Through the influence of time, that town now lies in ruins.

definition: to pull hard; to tug; to haul.
example_en: The children pulled hard at the rope from both sides.

definition: to assess, appraise the real and intrinsic value of an object or person (by not being influenced by the outward look).
example_en: One needs difficult times to truly assess a real friend.

definition: a beautiful ear.
example_en: The poet praised her beautiful ear in the poem.

definition: the chilli plant Capsicum minimum of Solanaceae family.
example_en: The farmer grew the needle-chilli plant in the garden.

definition: the condition of being overturned.
example: ದೋಣಿಯ ತಳಮೇಲು ಆಗಿ ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ನೀರಿಗೆ ಬಿದ್ದರು.
example_en: The boat got overturned and everyone fell into the water.

definition: one who draws or paints pictures.
example_en: That painter drew a beautiful picture.

definition: waste matter expelled from the bowels; excrement; faeces.
example_en: A dog's excrement was lying on the road.

definition: (dial.) a room with a bathtub, toilet, washstand, etc.
example_en: The new house had a large bathroom.

definition: any of the varieties of acacia trees.
example_en: Gum is obtained from the acacia tree.
